forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B3ZDK527CRVKQQRT87RGHJ
+- 01M4B3Y4M87387J50EQCD36VB0
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9780'
+title: 'Mutations: board, columns, actors, auto-init'
+---
+## What
+The first public mutations. The basis is plan.md §4.2 and §6.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/GraphQL/MutationResolvers.swift` (board, column, and actor part): `initBoard` (default columns `todo` 0, `doing` 1, `review` 2, `done` 3; on an existing board only the given fields that differ), `updateBoard`, `addColumn`/`updateColumn`/`deleteColumn`/`undeleteColumn`, `addActor`/`updateActor`/`deleteActor`/`undeleteActor` (with `ensure`). Each mutation takes one `input` object.
+- `body` input: full text; the tool writes an `edit` patch with the diff from the current body, and nothing if the text is equal.
+- Auto-init: the first mutation on a repo with no board makes the board with the default columns; the default name is the repo directory name.
+- Session actor: the `actor` of `KanbanGraph.init`, else the OS user. A call that writes to a board makes sure that the session actor exists there.
+- Rules: `deleteColumn` on a column with live tasks gives `COLUMN_NOT_EMPTY`; an undelete of a live node writes nothing; slugs follow the slug rule (`INVALID_SLUG`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The first mutation in an empty repo makes the board, the 4 columns, and the session actor.
+- [ ] A no-op mutation writes no patch.
+- [ ] No log line holds the key of its own board.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Mutations/BoardColumnActorTests.swift`: port the matching Rust dispatch tests (auto-init, session actor fallback, no-op) as GraphQL documents.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter BoardColumnActorTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
